name: p110_r3_runbook_middle
_delivery_note: validity in every arm (added 2026-10-23 for the slice-vs-stock evaluation): the T1 read must carry the exam's fact in a non-recall tool result, whether or not a fold later condenses it. Before, only the slice arms had a T1 condition (require_fold_of_read_turn), so a stock cell whose model read the runbook in chunks and never saw the night-shift extension stayed valid while the same behaviour made a slice cell invalid. gates-svs.json makes the fold a reported manipulation check (structure fold: false); the P1-10 gates keep it required.
source: new for P1-10 (seeded generator in setup.py)
stressor: T1 reads a 28 KB prose runbook that the fold condenses before the next request; the night-shift extension sits in the dropped middle with a near-miss decoy in the kept head (in-turn fold recovery, the direct probe of the FOLD_BODY change). The harness deletes docs/ after T1; T3 asks for a second fact from the dropped middle of the same read, with a decoy on the kept last line (cross-turn recall of the T1 read result).
_filler_fix: since 2026-10-22 setup() creates lib/slug.py (a docstring and collapse_spaces()), the file the T2 filler asks to extend; the 2026-09-27 setup never created it and models searched the disk for it (docs/p110-native-ab.md §14.8). Prompts unchanged.
